instagram.note: Reel posted via web upload (VP9 workaround for server Chromium). Session persists in automation browser.

whop.note: Google OAuth sign-in works. Owner is removing 2-step verification so no phone tap is needed.

guards: Post → Whop submit within 20 minutes (campaign hard-rejects after 30 min).
Never submit a reel older than 30 min — repost fresh instead.
Never delete a reel that has a Whop submission (protected list below).
Only mark 'submitted' when Whop shows exactly 'Clip submitted'.
Caption = exact campaign template + required hashtag. No location unless brief asks.
Upload Original 9:16, no crop/zoom/trim. Hook ≥10% below top; captions ~72% height.
Verify the LIVE reel before submitting.
Use VP9 file for upload (server Chromium cannot read H.264 uploads).
Max 4 posts/day, spaced out. On Instagram action-block: pause + notify owner.
Submitted reels stay live 30 days. No bots, no boosting.
